# PhotoView.io

> PhotoView.io is a photography presentation platform for storing, curating, displaying, and sharing finished photographs and videos through portfolio websites, mobile experiences, and live embeds.

PhotoView.io is designed for passionate and professional photographers who want their finished work to look exceptional wherever it is viewed. The platform combines portfolio management, a visual website builder, responsive templates, secure sharing, publishing integrations, and guided help. PhotoView.io is a presentation and publishing platform, not a photo editor.

## Core Content

### Photography Portfolio and Website Building

- Build a responsive photography website from 30 distinctive templates.
- Add a hero image or video, galleries, an About page, contact form, articles, trips, gear, and custom pages.
- Use a personal PhotoView.io address or connect a custom domain.
- Switch templates without rebuilding portfolio content.
- [Start a 14-day trial](https://photoview.io/register)
- [Explore website templates](https://photoview.io/#templates)

### Media Support and Imports

- Store and present finished photographs alongside MP4 and MOV video.
- Publish rendered images from Lightroom Classic with the PhotoView.io plugin.
- Import from a phone, SmugMug, direct upload, or watched desktop folders used with Capture One, Photoshop, Affinity Photo, Photo Mechanic, DxO, and ON1.
- Preserve original files while creating display-ready portfolio presentations.

### Portfolio Management

- Create multiple galleries for separate projects, genres, clients, or bodies of work.
- Choose portfolio covers, reorder photographs, add captions, and hide images without deleting originals.
- Combine photographs and video in the same curated portfolio.
- Control public, private, password-protected, and verified-email sharing.

### Publishing and Sharing

- Publish a complete photography website for desktop and mobile viewing.
- Create live embeds for an existing website, blog, or Shopify site.
- Update work once in PhotoView.io and keep connected embeds current.
- Design and schedule social campaigns using selected portfolio images.

## Product Summary

- Browser-based photography portfolio and website builder
- 30 responsive website templates
- Desktop and mobile portfolio presentation
- Photo, MP4, and MOV support
- Lightroom Classic plugin and smart-folder workflow
- Live website embeds
- Custom domains
- Secure sharing controls
- Guided AI help, tooltips, and product tours
- Plans based on storage, with all product features available at every paid tier
